{{Quote|Sir, are we under attack?|Pop-Dog Clerk to Stavin Thaal|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]], who posed as a clerk at [[Major Saving's Army Surplus]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Trey Courser]] and [[Drikall Bessarah]], members of the recently reformed Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], approached the store while Courser was disguised as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] using a [[neoglith masquer]]. The man, who was actually serving as a guard at the building, was fooled by Courser's disguise and allowed the two Wraiths to enter with an unconscious [[Ledina Chott]], a famous local [[Musician/Legends|musician]] whom they kidnapped. He escorted them to a hidden freight lift leading to an underground facility and operated the lift's controls. When Chott began to stir, Bessarah [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the false clerk with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="MK" />
